Wrote docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-029.md for WF02-REQ-029 (QR check-in via ci_<token> deep link) at branch feature/WF02-REQ-029, commit 684b677. Scope test: Step 2's artifacts_out (domain/registration.ts's new getRegistrationByQrTokenForCheckin/getCheckinActorDisplayName/decideQrCheckinOutcome/performQrCheckIn/decideOverrideOutcome/overrideAdmitAndCheckIn/getRegistrationDisplayInfo; domain/eventStaffAuthorization.ts's extended requireEventStaffForEvent/buildCheckinRefusalAudit; domain/event.ts's extended parseStartPayload; handlers/start.ts's extended makeStartHandler; new handlers/checkinQr.ts; index.ts's new checkin:override:<id> callback wiring; new checkinQr.* i18n keys) is real behavioral surface -- a real /start ci_<token> deep-link dispatch writing real registrations/audit_log rows. Full Steps 3b/4 apply.

Read core-directives.md, WF-02 Step 3, qa_testing_guide.md, docs/agents/test-specs/REQ-028.md as reference shape, docs/agents/design/REQ-029.md in full, apps/bot/src/handlers/checkinQr.ts and the relevant apps/bot/src/domain/registration.ts additions (getRegistrationByQrTokenForCheckin, performQrCheckIn, decideQrCheckinOutcome, overrideAdmitAndCheckIn, decideOverrideOutcome, withdrawRegistration, registerForEvent, promoteFromWaitlistIfEligible -- the real implementations, full reads), and BACKEND-DEV's already-committed apps/bot/src/handlers/checkinQr.db.test.ts in full (9 tests covering AC1-AC6) so this spec's own cases are independently parameterized, not duplicates. Also confirmed apps/bot/src/db/schema.ts's registrations.updatedAt has no .$onUpdate() and no Postgres trigger sets it anywhere in apps/bot/drizzle/*.sql (grep for TRIGGER returned nothing) -- so updated_at cannot serve as a genuine zero-write proxy in this schema; used Postgres's own hidden xmin system column instead (a real MVCC tuple-version proof, independent of which columns a SET clause names).

Per-case design, all for a SECOND, NEW test file this spec designs, apps/bot/src/handlers/checkinQr.forgery.test.ts -- THIS FILE DOES NOT EXIST YET. Per this project's established convention (confirmed precedent: checkin.forgery.test.ts for REQ-028, reminder24h.forgery.test.ts for REQ-026, event.dispatch.test.ts for REQ-027), TEST-DESIGNER writes the markdown design only; TEST-RUNNER writes and commits the actual vitest file at Step 4 once this design passes Step 3b. Own nextTgId=942_000_000+ range, confirmed distinct from every existing file's range via grep -rn "nextTgId = " apps/bot/src (800M/900M/900M/920M/940M/941M[BACKEND-DEV's own checkinQr.db.test.ts]/950M/950M/960M/970M/980M/990M/1000000900).

- AC1: own cross-event-EventStaff fixture (a user who genuinely IS EventStaff for a DIFFERENT event scans this event's token) -- BACKEND-DEV's AC1 fixture is a plain member never staff anywhere, which cannot distinguish 'never staff' from 'staff, but not for this event.'
- AC2: own fixture plus a genuine storage-layer zero-write proof via xmin (before/after the second scan) -- stronger than a value-unchanged assertion alone, since it would also catch an accidental no-op UPDATE that writes back identical values.
- AC3: own single-registrant fixture cycled through waitlisted -> requested -> withdrawn on the SAME row, asserting the override button's callback_data/label on all three scans -- BACKEND-DEV's own AC3 coverage never asserts the override button on the waitlisted/requested branches.
- AC5: own two-attendee fixture adding a company: null sub-case (the companyPlaceholder 'omitted with its separator when null' branch, design section 7) with an explicit assertion that no orphan ' -- ' separator appears -- BACKEND-DEV's AC5 fixture always populates company, so this branch has no existing coverage.
- AC6: own positive fixture, plus a negative case using an organizer scoped to a DIFFERENT chapter (tests requireOrganizerForChapter's chapter-scoping specifically) -- BACKEND-DEV's own negative case is a plain EventStaff volunteer with no organizer role anywhere, which cannot expose a chapter-scoping regression.
- Stale-token recheck (S4): a case with NO existing coverage anywhere in this codebase, flagged by both SECURITY-REVIEWER and CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR as reachable but untested (performQrCheckIn's design section 3.3 step 2 token-currency recheck). Constructed via a genuine re-registration (register admitted -> withdrawRegistration -> registerForEvent again on the SAME event/user, confirmed same registrationId reused per REQ-022, new qrToken issued) producing a real superseded old token T1 and a real current token T2. Reasoned explicitly in the spec why a full /start dispatch of T1 alone is insufficient to reach the actual recheck line (the unlocked lookup by qr_token already returns null for a superseded token before performQrCheckIn is ever called, under ordinary sequential execution -- the recheck line is only reachable via performQrCheckIn's own registrationId+qrToken parameter pairing, which a race could trigger nondeterministically but a direct call reaches deterministically with the same real, domain-produced inputs). Designed two sub-cases: (A) full dispatch of the old token proving the ordinary user-facing 'refused as unknown' behavior end to end, (B) a direct performQrCheckIn(db, R, T1, ...) call asserting outcome.kind === 'unknown-token' plus an xmin zero-write proof plus zero new audit rows -- this is the one that actually exercises the design section 3.3 step 2 line.

AC4 deliberately not re-covered: BACKEND-DEV's own committed cases (unknown token; valid token after ends_at) already drive through real dispatch with adequate own-fixture coverage, no gap found reading checkinQr.db.test.ts directly. AC7 is a git grep check (git grep -i "web_app|webapp|mini.?app" apps/bot/src expected to return nothing), not a vitest case -- stated as a TEST-RUNNER Step 4 action, not designed as a test.

Stated the --no-file-parallelism requirement (ISS-0014) for TEST-RUNNER, and that this file must not run concurrently with any other DB-backed vitest file against the same scratch Postgres. No implementation defect found in the read domain/registration.ts, eventStaffAuthorization.ts, or handlers/checkinQr.ts code while reading it directly for this step -- nothing new to file under ISSUE_QUEUE.md.
